thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: prod inference p95 > 600ms (current ~1.2s) for model redwood/optimize-v1 in us-west-2. Endpoint POST /v1/generate. Observed increase in timeouts and 5xx. Paging @eng-oncall.

marta: i'm on call, joining. pulling dashboards and deploy history.

kevin: grafana: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/xyz789/prod-inference. quick numbers — baseline (01:40-02:00 UTC) p50 ~85ms, p95 ~300ms. spike begins ~02:12 UTC -> p50 ~150ms, p95 ~1.2s. rps steady, error rate +~1.7%.

sanjay: checking node health. vmstat shows increased page faults and kswapd waking. sample vmstat snapshot:
```
procs -----------memory---------- ---swap-- -----io---- -system-- ----cpu----
 r  b   swpd   free   buff  cache   si   so    bi    bo   in   cs us sy id wa st
 2  1      0  124M   12M   1.4G    0    0    120   340 250k 420k 30 10 55  5  0
```
/proc/vmstat shows pgfault/pgmajfault jumps around 02:12.

olivia: any infra rollouts recently?
deploy-bot: INFRA-ROLL: kernel image infra-kernel-5.15.10 rolled to us-west-2 canary pool at 01:58 UTC (canary=10% nodes).

tim: that aligns with spike start. hypothesis: kernel mm/kswapd/reclaim behavior causing tail latency under our model memory patterns.

marta: canary rollback approved? @eng-oncall please confirm.

eng-oncall: approved, initiating rollback on canary pool to infra-kernel-5.15.9 now.

deploy-bot: Started rollback: infra-kernel-image=5.15.9 on pool inference-canary-usw2 (20 nodes). Progress -> 20/20.

kevin: collected traces from impacted requests. many traces show long blocking in task/sched waiting. example trace (id t-abc001): [recv: 6ms] [decode: 48ms] [gpu_submit: 30ms] [sched_wait: 820ms] [resp_write: 12ms]. trace excerpt:
```
span root 0-1000ms
  decode 5-53ms
  model_infer 53-85ms
    gpu_submit 58-63ms
    task_wait 63-883ms  <-- blocking span
  write 883-895ms
```

sanjay: running perf sampling on node: hot symbols: mm_fault_error_code, __handle_mm_fault, mm_reclaim, kswapd_do_work. perf counters show ctx-switches/min x3 and page_faults/min +25% during spike window.

olivia: CS: Customer A reported timeouts, Customer B seeing degraded SLA. CS notified customers and posted initial outbound.

marta: timeline update: 01:58 UTC kernel 5.15.10 canary -> 02:12 UTC p95 rising -> 02:20 UTC alert -> 02:22 UTC rollback start -> 02:28 UTC canary rollback complete -> 02:31 UTC p95 on canary nodes back near ~350ms.

tim: rollback on canary improved latency — supports kernel-related hypothesis. cluster-wide not fully back yet (non-canary nodes still impacted). next actions: collect perf.data + vmstats from affected hosts, gather full trace bundle, review kernel 5.15.10 changelog for mm/kswapd/preempt/CONFIG diffs, coordinate with eng-kernel & eng-infra on bisect/revert. assign @sanjay, @kevin, @marta.

sanjay: uploading artifacts now -> s3://redwood-incidents/3119990000/perf_and_logs.tar.gz (includes /proc/vmstat, /proc/zoneinfo, perf.data).

kevin: uploaded trace bundle -> s3://redwood-incidents/3119990000/traces_bundle.tar.gz. linked to incident doc.

marta: incident doc: https://incidents.redwood.example/3119990000 (added artifact links).

eng-kernel: acknowledged. asking for exact kernel config diff and commit list between 5.15.9 -> 5.15.10. we'll triage reclaim/kswapd changes and known regressions.

eng-infra: we've paused further kernel rollouts and pinned inference fleet to 5.15.9. scheduling a controlled canary test with synthetic memory pressure workload.

kevin: commands we used for collection:
```
ssh node-45
sudo perf record -a -g -o /tmp/perf.data -- sleep 30
sudo perf script -i /tmp/perf.data | gzip > /tmp/perf.script.gz
cat /proc/vmstat > /tmp/vmstat.txt
cat /proc/zoneinfo > /tmp/zoneinfo.txt
cat /proc/interrupts > /tmp/interrupts.txt
```

olivia: CS outbound updated: brief note on degraded latency, mitigation steps in progress, ETA for next technical update + link to status page.

marta: follow-ups: 1) eng-kernel to bisect commits and report candidate commit(s), 2) eng-infra to coordinate controlled canary and gating, 3) eng-ml to run synthetic memory access patterns against canary nodes, 4) write RCA doc and retro. owners: eng-kernel, eng-infra, sanjay.

eng-oncall: severity set S2 (mitigated on canary; partial cluster degradation persists). next update by 10:00 UTC.

incident-bot: Incident state: Mitigated on canary; Partial cluster degradation persists. Artifacts: incident doc + S3 bundles (see links above).
